title: Flatten and unflatten a dict
hints: flatten: write an inner function walk(node, prefix) that loops over node.items(); build path = prefix + sep + key (no sep when prefix is empty).
Recurse only when isinstance(value, dict) and value is non-empty; everything else, including {}, is stored as flat[path] = value.
unflatten: for each key, split on sep; walk the leading parts with node = node.setdefault(part, {}), then assign the last part.
For the conflict: if setdefault hands you something that is not a dict, or the final slot already holds a non-empty dict, raise ValueError.
